title: Pass data between jobs
prompt: Generate a version string in one job and consume it in another using job outputs.
objective: Demonstrate the behavior of pass data between jobs and capture verifiable evidence.

starter.code:
name: Pass a small value between jobs
on: workflow_dispatch
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      label: ${{ steps.make.outputs.label }}
    steps:
      - id: make
        run: echo "label=demo-${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  consume:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          LABEL: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.label }}
        run: echo "Received label=$LABEL"

expected_output: A reviewed workflow or design note satisfying: GITHUB_OUTPUT, outputs:, needs:. Verify behavior on a disposable repository where execution is required; a static sketch is not proof of a live deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Explain one validation result or limitation.
Do not include a real secret or use production resources.
hints: First identify the trigger, input, and expected result.

Compare your result with the linked lesson and official documentation; distinguish a configuration sketch from a live integration.
